title: I Punched a Monster Over the Mountains (Part 1)
summary: A quiet baker’s kid stops a castle-sized monster with three punches, then discovers an iron-filled training sack and a letter from his father.
frame_0: A flour-dusted boy braces his fist against the Gatewarden’s raised stone foot. Its gold eyes look down over the bakery yard. The title and HUS tag appear above the action.
package_differences: Jake requested a continuous moving camera and rapid three-hit training chants. The four training phrases each last 0.482 seconds, with the original narrator, Dad, King and story clock retained.
The four original training phrases came from the clean stereo mix. The separate monster punches, Dad’s voices from the ridge and the final single response retain their original timing.
The harvest training takes place in an earlier memory. The opening count runs from 10,941 to 10,944, and the third monster punch and Dad’s letter both reach 10,950.

The story ends at 147.0 seconds. The sponsor revision adds a top-right 360-pixel Flashloop card, the top-left channel handle and a five-second phone demonstration using two original ridge scenes from this story.
sponsor_approval: Pending. Claude sends for-sponsor-review.mp4 to Flashloop before posting.
